name: net.nrzk.vfstub
description: Stand-in for VRCFury in projects without it. Keeps VRCFury component types (VF.* namespace, same GUIDs) so existing scenes and prefabs load, and, when NDMF and Modular Avatar are installed, provides VRCFury's inspectors for SPS Plug/Socket, Global Collider and Haptic Touch. No build processing is included; SPSNDMF Migrator converts the SPS-related components (Plug/Socket, Global Collider, Haptic Touch) for SPS for NDMF at build time.
